The current StructureDefinition source preserves the requested CommunicationRequest requester, recipient, and informationProvider wording and the Communication recipient/sender wording.
additional_context: Communication and CommunicationRequest are active Patient Care resources in source/fhir.ini. Later same-family work refined the renamed element and nearby targets: FHIR-22631 changed informationProvider cardinality and already has a combined-branch source correction for the notes page, FHIR-22630 added Endpoint target types, and FHIR-26951 is already represented by a combined-branch audit commit. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Active conformance source, search parameter bundles, workflow mapping exceptions, and the current CommunicationRequest notes page already use CommunicationRequest.informationProvider and the final information-sharing descriptions. The remaining current-source CommunicationRequest.sender occurrences found were a historical fhir.ini alias and an older workflow warning suppression entry, not active implementer-facing element definitions.
